task: Check whether an exported multi-statement generic arithmetic body can be specialized from ABI-v10 artifacts after deleting the provider source.
observation: The test was expected to exercise the checked-body-v1 importer, but all three source-free consumers passed through the generic_stmt import path. The provider interface contained generic_stmt records and no checked-body-v1 record; the multi-statement arithmetic body has no checked_body_v1 projection.
impact: The successful runtime result alone could have been misattributed to checked-body support. Inspecting the serialized interface and generated specialization showed the actual generic IR path and avoided an unnecessary compiler change.
evidence: src/moss.cpp:35636 parse_generic_ir_line reads generic_stmt records into Function::body
src/moss.cpp:3741 retain_checked_body_ir supports only empty-body result expressions or one Return statement
src/checked_body_ir.hpp:641 decode_h3_checked_body_v1 is a separate checked-body importer

resolution.summary: The requested source-free cases succeed through serialized generic IR and consumer-side checking/specialization; no fix is justified for this reproducer.
